notes: I fixed the capitalization order: the box lowercases the whole string, inserts "10" at `len//2`, then capitalizes the first character of the result. This explains why `"A"` → `"10a"` and `"x"` → `"10x"` (the original first letter is no longer first after insertion, so it stays lowercase), while `"ab"` → `"A10b"` still capitalizes correctly.
